verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms the operator can open and scan mail contents on request (not just photograph envelopes), which addresses part of the story, but there is no mention of scans being delivered as searchable PDFs nor any stated turnaround time (same/next business day) commitment. Missing for 10: explicit searchable-PDF output format, stated SLA/turnaround time for scanning requests, independent corroboration of actual scan quality/speed.
